units.canonical_text: Use the AWS global network service shown here to manage a wide area network across Regions while keeping workloads segmented. The core network policy defines segments, assigns attachments, and controls routing so production and development do not become one flat network.

units.canonical_text: A Transit Gateway is a regional routing hub. The global network service fits many networks that need one shared policy across Regions. Separate segments do not share routes automatically. Check that the policy explicitly allows the routes you need to share and that the relevant attachments exist.
